verdict.rationale: Codegen exposes a Python SDK and REST API for programmatically creating and running agents with full control, and can be triggered from CI/CD pipelines — this enables scripting bulk operations (e.g., looping agent.run calls across many PRs/issues) even though no dedicated 'batch' or 'bulk' endpoint is documented. Missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk API primitive, rate-limit/scale guidance, and any hands-on evidence of running many concurrent agents successfully.
